article.title: Cluster Your Embeddings 5x Faster on a CPU: A Hands-On e-means Tutorial

data.text:
k-means is the slow step in most embedding pipelines.

Meta's new e-means is a 3-line swap, already in faiss-cpu. On 100k OpenAI embeddings, CPU only: 4.8x faster than 25 Lloyd iterations, with lower held-out error.

Full tutorial below 👇
